title: Interfacial gradient engineering synergized with self-adaptive cathodic defense for durable Zn-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02236C, Paper
Quan Zong, Xuelian Liu, Qilong Zhang, Qiaoling Kang, Fan Wang, Guoying Wei, Anqiang Pan
A diethyl pyrophosphoramide additive optimizes the interfacial chemistry of the cathode, regulates the electrolyte structure, and in situ forms a gradient SEI on the anode, achieving a stable and reversible Zn-ion battery.
